class Foo {

  void test(int a) {
    var b = a.plus(1);
    var c = a.plus(1, 2);
    print("b: " + b + " ; c: " + c);
  }

}
static class NumExt {

  public static int plus(this int self, int a) {
    return self + a;
  }

  public static int plus(this int self, int a, int b) {
    return (self + a) + b;
  }

}
